verses.text: Then Yahweh said to Job,
“Do you still want to argue with me, the Almighty One?
Then Job replied to Yahweh,
“Now I realize that I am completely worthless. So ◄how could I answer those questions?/I could not possibly answer those questions!► [RHQ]
I have already said more than I should have said,
Then Yahweh again spoke to Job from inside the great windstorm. He said,
“I want to ask you some more questions.
“Are you going to accuse me and say that I am unjust?
Are you as powerful [MTY] as I am?
If you can do that, put on the robes
Show that you are very angry;
Humble those proud people just by looking at them angrily
Bury them in the ground!
After you do that, I will congratulate/praise you
“Think also about the huge animals that live near the water.
Their legs/thighs are very strong,
Their tails are stiff (OR, bend down) like the branches of a cedar tree.
Their thigh bones are like tubes made of bronze,
They are among the strongest of the animals that I made,
On the hills grows food [PRS] for them to eat
They lie down in the water under the lotus plants;
Those huge animals find shade under the lotus plants,
They are not disturbed by raging/swiftly-flowing rivers;
No one can [RHQ] catch them by blinding their eyes
